arguments.question: For NVDA over 21/63 sessions, use the latest FY2027 Q2 10-Q and Q2 earnings release to identify measured demand, concentration/geographic/export-control, supply/commitment, margin, and forward-guidance exposures. Assess whether the filings quantify any sensitivity to customer AI-infrastructure financing or cost of capital. Required evidence: cite the specific SEC/issuer disclosures and dates; distinguish disclosed facts from inference. Stop once you establish whether a measured interest-rate/financing transmission exists or identify it as unquantified.
arguments.decision_impact: Could change the draft if issuer disclosures show a measured or clearly proximate demand/cash-flow vulnerability to monetary conditions, or if core operational risks dominate the 21/63-session catalyst set.
